messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: release v3.14 -> rolling US/EU/APAC. Start 2026-03-20 18:30 UTC. Initial slices: US 10% -> EU 20% -> APAC 10%. Change window 2h. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v3.14 :rocket:

sasha: Can we run a quick capacity check for APAC dedicated pools before we push there? last time pool-apac-small flapped and caused fallback churn.

marc: Running: ./scripts/capacity-check --region=apac --pools=pool-apac-large,pool-apac-small

```
pool-apac-large: total_gpus=20 used=2 free=18 memory_util=78% avg_latency_ms=42
pool-apac-small: total_gpus=8 used=8 free=0 memory_util=92% pending_jobs=3
reserved_quota: 60%
```

marc: small pool is saturated, large looks warm but memory util is on the high side. pending_jobs are nightly batch jobs starting at 19:00 local.

maya: Noted. APAC small at 0 free — we should avoid routing inference-heavy models to small until that drains. Can we set a traffic cushion rule to exclude pool-apac-small until free>2?

ben-sre: Agreed. Also after US canary, watch EU P95. If EU P95 increases >1200ms hold the EU slice.

deploy-bot: Canary US started at 10% for release v3.14 — metrics: p50 34ms p95 210ms error_rate 0.0% logs: https://redwood.metrics/canary/us/v3.14

lina-prod: US canary looks clean. I'm seeing token cost down ~6% with the new quant profile.

oliver-eng: Re: pinning — let's pin EU to v3.13 as a fallback. Trigger: errors >0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes OR latency spike >500ms.

sasha: Setting cushion: rollapac.cushion=20% (min free capacity) and adding pool filter to exclude pool-apac-small. Also scheduling preflight KV warmup for APAC to avoid cache-miss storm.

```
# ops snippet
redwoodctl rollout set --region apac --exclude-pool pool-apac-small --min-free 2
redwoodctl warmup --region apac --model transformer-xl --kv-prefix preflight-v3.14
```

ben-sre: I'll watch dashboards and stand by with rollback playbook. Rollback command if triggered:

```
redwoodctl rollback --region eu --version v3.13 --reason "latency spike"
```

maya: Ops plan: hold APAC at 10% for 30m after EU reaches 20% and is stable for 15m. If any region hits >1% errors for 5m, auto-fallback to pinned version for that region.

deploy-bot: EU slice at 20% started — metrics: p95 240ms error_rate 0.12% (within threshold).

marc: APAC preflight warmup succeeded. pool-apac-small remains saturated but is excluded from routing. free_gpus adjusted accordingly.

sasha: Proceeding: APAC increase to 20% conditional in 10m if EU stable for the next 15m. tagging release-note: prioritize cushion and exclude small pool.

ops-bot: Reminder: Change window ends 2026-03-20 20:30 UTC. If no issues, full rollout planned at 21:00 UTC.

lina-prod: LGTM. I'll update #incidents if SLOs degrade. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rollout progress: US 10% -> 50% (in flight), EU 20% stable, APAC 10% held. Next step scheduled in ~12m.

oliver-eng: One more ask — throttle burst for embeddings endpoint in APAC to 60rps while small pool remains excluded.

sasha: Done: embedding.throttle.apac=60rps. Updated the rollout config.

ben-sre: Monitoring... setting a 15m watch window. If error >0.5% escalate to oncall.

deploy-bot: Noted. Thread closed for scheduling; ping here for any immediate updates. :white_check_mark:
